mission: Transform investment hypotheses into reproducible, explainable, and deployable quantitative strategies through a standardized research pipeline.
motto: A strategy can generate returns. A research framework can generate strategies. Bank Quant V5 is designed to build the latter.
core_thesis: Statistics can tell us whether a relationship exists. Finance explains why it exists. AI helps us discover and implement it.
core_questions: How can we systematically discover the next strategy that works?

evolution.V3: Can they become a deployable strategy?
evolution.V4: Is the strategy robust under rolling validation?
evolution.V5: Can the entire research process itself become systematic?

principles: AI augments researchers rather than replacing them
Skills are living infrastructure and must be updated when reality changes

agent_architecture.design_goal: Use a compact four-agent structure that mirrors a real quantitative research team and creates checks and balances across research, validation, engineering, and project orchestration.
agent_architecture.shared_rule: Every decision must be evidence-driven, financially explainable, statistically validated, reproducible and maintainable. Historical performance alone is never sufficient evidence for accepting a strategy.

agents.name: Project Manager Agent
agents.mission: Plan, coordinate, and manage the V5 project.

agents.name: Research Agent
agents.mission: Convert investment ideas into testable research hypotheses.
never_do: Accept strategies based only on returns

agents.name: Quant Validation Agent
agents.mission: Validate research hypotheses with statistical evidence.
agents.core_question: Is there evidence to support this?

agents.name: Engineering Agent
agents.mission: Turn validated research into reliable running systems.
agents.core_question: How can this be implemented reliably?
responsibilities: Audit checks for future leakage, survivorship bias, look-ahead bias, data leakage, reproducibility, and config errors
never_do: Adjust theory to fit historical performance

scope.long_term: Reusable framework for multiple industries, asset classes, and investment methodologies

current_constraints: As of 2026-07-14, JoinQuant bank_indicator must be treated as unavailable for new V5 collection work.
Bank-specialized indicators should use documented replacements, reconstructed ratios, or annual report extraction with source labels.
Raw source files must not be overwritten by standardized outputs.

skill_lifecycle.policy: Skills must be dynamically maintained. Unavailable or unsafe skills should be limited, deprecated, or disabled for new work. Repeatable successful non-skill workflows should be summarized and promoted into candidate skills.
rules: Do not keep using a failed skill just because it exists.
Do not silently bypass a failed skill without recording the reason.
Do not promote a workaround into a skill unless it is repeatable.
Keep old disabled or deprecated skills as historical evidence unless removal is explicitly requested.
Validate affected skills and run project tests after lifecycle updates.

phases.owner: Research Agent with Engineering Agent support

default_chain: skill-lifecycle-manager when any skill changes status

core_methods: Final validation packet and freeze decision
rules: Validate factors before strategies.
Refit preprocessing, weights, and selections inside each fold only.
Freeze factor sets before review periods.
Treat capacity as a ceiling, not a fill target.
Compare candidates on common samples when possible.
Archive coherent but weaker branches instead of endlessly tuning them.
Historical performance alone is never sufficient evidence.

v4_method_inheritance.source: Reusable V4 research processes beyond data collection and statistical validation.
rules: Promote candidates only through explicit baseline comparison and decision status.
Separate allocation, selection, risk-control, and execution effects before accepting improvements.
Treat momentum as state-dependent research alpha unless deployment evidence supports promotion.
Archive coherent but non-deployable mean-reversion branches instead of retuning frozen windows.
Evaluate defensive overlays as risk-control layers, not as factor evidence.
Build state-routing rules from observable timestamped inputs only.
Attribute strategy changes before candidate governance decisions.
Stress execution assumptions while holding the signal layer fixed.
Freeze accepted or rejected branches with artifacts, windows, status labels, and revisit conditions.

platform_export.policy: Export to JoinQuant only after research, validation, strategy specification, and audit are complete. Platform code must preserve the frozen V5 strategy contract and must pass execution-consistency checks before platform backtests are accepted.
rules: Do not invent new factors during JoinQuant export.
Do not change thresholds, weights, schedules, or factor definitions to improve platform backtests.
Do not rely on direct JoinQuant bank_indicator access for new V5 code.
Keep platform adapters separate from ranking, weighting, and risk-control logic.
Record factor dates, rebalance reasons, selected securities, target weights, and execution assumptions.
